original_model_equivalence: Exact fixed-seed CPU state keys/initialization, predictions, input/parameter gradients and RNG; evidence retained in archive/provenance
portable_resume: Exact CPU parameters, optimizer/RNG progress and loss for uninterrupted versus resumed synthetic-fixture training
calibration: Held-out IDs and counts checked; no test pixel loading before fit; separate empirical/reference/native protocols
limitations: CPU fixture tests do not certify full CUDA training or numerical equality across hardware.
